abstract.t: This document specifies the Deterministic Evidence and Witness Protocol (DEWP), a format for tamper-evident audit commitments and offline evidence verification. It defines canonical event preimages, domain-separated hashing, two-tier Merkle inclusion proofs, per- tenant sequence checks, checkpoint continuity, and independently verifiable anchor evidence. Verifiers report content, commitment, embedded-signature, and anchor verification separately. Completeness checks cover committed events within the evaluated range; they cannot prove that an event was never withheld before commitment or that a committed description accurately records a real-world action. Version 1.1 adds execution evidence: a record that an approved action was dispatched, statements signed by independent evidence sources about whether it took effect, and a status a verifier derives under its own trust; that status reports what a trusted source observed, not what physically happened. The specification also defines a streaming format that the reference implementations do not yet implement.
